snippet.title: Loopquarium - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Loopquarium is an aquarium roguelike where you assemble a school of fish with unique abilities to repel invading apex predators.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4875190/Loopquarium/
